name: Henyey-Greenstein Phase Function
definition: A phase function model that samples a direction and returns the probability of that direction, controlled by an asymmetry parameter $g$.
summary: The Henyey-Greenstein phase function is a parametric, anisotropic model that describes light scattering directionality in participating media using a single asymmetry parameter, distinguished by its simple algebraic form lacking wavelength dependence.
